opentimestamps_verification_method: When a completed proof is available, verify its path against Bitcoin block headers from Blockstream and mempool.space. No local full-node verification.

rfc3161.root_certificate_source: Local certifi CA trust store; public key matches the G4 cross-signed certificate linked by DigiCert.
rfc3161.verification: OpenSSL verified timestamp signature and chain using the trusted self-signed DigiCert Trusted Root G4. Verified both the ZIP digest and original nonce-bearing request. The root public key was cross-checked against DigiCert documentation.
commands: openssl ts -verify -data forecast-2026-11-02-snapshot.zip -in forecast.tsr -CAfile digicert-root.pem -untrusted timestamp-chain.pem
openssl ts -verify -queryfile forecast.tsq -in forecast.tsr -CAfile digicert-root.pem -untrusted timestamp-chain.pem
